title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
陈青云见她没动静，也紧紧靠着她娇嫩的肌肤，似乎贪恋这一刻的旖旎，不愿离开。房间里暧昧气氛，越来越热烈，眼看就要彻底爆发……“叮铃铃！”关键时刻，江颜的手机突然响了。她拿起来一看，脸色大变，忍不住惊呼出声：“是杨天明的电话，青云，快起来，如果被他听出什么，我们都要完蛋！”听到这话，陈青云瞬间打了个激灵，从疯狂中回过神来。他从江颜的身子上爬起来，望着她那副衣衫不整、楚楚可怜的模样，忍不住心生愧疚：“颜姐，我刚才是鬼迷心窍，你千万别往心里去！”江颜白了他一眼，随后接通了电话，应付了杨天明几句。陈青云也不敢继续呆下去，连忙整理了一下衣服，急匆匆离开了别墅。很快，江颜就挂断了电话，但心情还没有平复。刚才若非杨天明打来电话，她说不定就真的和陈青云……事实上，她的内心深处，隐隐也有意思期待和渴望。可她毕竟是个传统的女人，这些年来守身如玉，面对无数追求者，向来都是不假颜色。陈青云那大胆的举动，已经激发她埋藏的慾望，现在她一个人呆在空荡荡的卧室，却突然有些寂寞，似乎想要有个男人来温暖。犹豫了片刻，江颜躺在了床上，闭上眼睛，脑海中竟然开始幻想着陈青云的样子……很快，卧室内传来了一阵婉转的娇哼。另一边，陈青云回到了家，内心激动的同时又有些后怕。他也不知道是怎么了，今晚竟然差点把江颜给强上了，还好在最后一步悬崖勒马，否则被杨天明发现，那他彻底没法在松山县混了！陈青云洗了个热水澡，然后上床睡觉。这一夜，他做了个梦，梦中有个女子与他翻云覆雨。起初是江颜那妩媚的样子，之后变成了端庄典雅的白婉茹。最后，那女子竟然变成了唐县长的女儿，唐灵儿！唐灵儿才十八岁，在省城读大学，陈青云和她只见过一面，却对她天使般的清纯容颜印象深刻。……第二天早上。“叮铃铃！”闹铃响起，惊醒了陈青云的美梦。他洗漱一番，前往县政府上班。还没走进办公室，就听到同事的一阵议论。“听说了么，杨副县长恐怕没法更进一步！”“市里要派一个新县长过来，才30岁，据说还是个女的！”“真的假的？这么年轻的女县长，恐怕有什么天大的背景吧！”这时，陈青云走进了秘书科。刚才还在交头接耳的几个同事，纷纷作鸟兽散，根本不和陈青云打招呼，仿佛将他视为空气。这也难怪，之前陈青云是县长秘书，风光无限，难免招人嫉妒。现在唐县长车祸身亡，陈青云恐怕也要坐冷板凳，大家都等着看笑话。又过了几分钟，一个五短身材的男子走了进来。正是秘书科的科长，戴斌。

“陈青云来了啊？最近水利局缺人，你借调过去帮帮忙，为期半年，看守水库！”戴斌拍了拍他的肩膀，笑眯眯的，但眼神格外阴狠。看水库？这不是发配贬职么？“戴科长，这恐怕不太妥当吧？我的编制在县政府办，而不是水利局。”陈青云沉声道。“这是组织的决定，难道你要违抗么？”戴斌抬高声音，直接给他扣了一顶大帽子。但陈青云也不是软柿子，当即反驳：“那请问戴科长，是县里哪位领导下的决定，还是说领导们都不知道，是你在搞鬼？”闻言，戴斌索性也不装了，猛地一拍桌子。“是我下的命令，又怎么样？”“实话告诉你，有我戴斌在秘书科一天，你陈青云就永远没有出头之日！”“不愿意去看水库？那你就辞职滚蛋吧！”戴斌唾沫星子飞溅，嚣张无比。他是前任县长的秘书，而唐志华上位后，嫌弃他笔头水平不行，选择了更年轻的陈青云，这让他怀恨在心。但他和陈青云，还有别的过节。他老婆苏瑶，是陈青云前女友的姐姐，有次苏瑶在床上和他办事，喊的竟然是陈青云的名字！虽然他知道妻子和陈青云不可能有一腿，但她肯定幻想过这个高大帅气的妹夫！而戴斌五短身材，大腹便便，哪里比的上陈青云？“反正话我是放在这儿了，如果你不愿意去看水库，那就是对抗组织，给处分都是轻的！”戴斌阴森森说道。“好，我去！不过最迟一周，我就能回来，咱们走着瞧！”陈青云也放了话，之所以这么说，自然是有底气。虽然他失去了唐县长这个靠山，但又抱上了江颜的大腿，想要官复原职，并非难事。……离开县政府办后，陈青云就打了辆车，前往郊外的水库，和水库站长交接工作。这站长明显收到戴斌的命令，给陈青云安排了最辛苦的夜班，要从傍晚18点工作到第二天早上6点。陈青云也没多说什么，但心中已经决定，一定要狠狠打戴斌的脸！“轰隆隆！”到了午夜时分，突然一辆奥迪车驶来，停在水库门口，还挂着市里的牌照。一个年轻女子下了车，她身材高挑，穿着西装，美腿包裹着丝袜，脚踩高跟鞋。虽然看不清长相，但这身打扮，一看就是大城市的时髦女郎。“大半夜的，她来水库干什么？”陈青云坐在监控室内，观察着她的举动。只见那西装女子走到水库边缘，四处张望。突然，不远处的草丛中窜出一条毒蛇，猩红的獠牙在她身上咬了一口。“啊啊啊……有蛇，救命啊！”女子发出呼救，但脚下一滑，竟然扑通一声摔进水库里，溅起一片水花……　　请记住本书首发域名：fzhldax。顶点小说网手机版阅读网址：fzhldax

Seeing that she was motionless, Chen Qingyun also leaned against her delicate skin, as if he was greedy for the charm of this moment and did not want to leave.The ambiguous atmosphere in the room was getting more and more heated, and it was about to explode completely... "Ding, ding, ding, ding!" At the critical moment, Jiang Yan's cell phone suddenly rang.When she picked it up and looked at it, her face changed drastically and she couldn't help but exclaimed: "It's Yang Tianming's call, Qingyun, get up quickly, if he hears anything, we will all be dead!" Hearing this, Chen Qingyun instantly trembled and recovered from his madness.He got up from Jiang Yan's body and looked at her disheveled and pitiful appearance. He couldn't help but feel guilty: "Sister Yan, I was obsessed just now. Don't take it to heart!" Jiang Yan rolled her eyes at him, then answered the phone and said a few words to Yang Tianming.Chen Qingyun did not dare to stay any longer. He quickly arranged his clothes and left the villa in a hurry.Soon, Jiang Yan hung up the phone, but her mood had not calmed down yet.If Yang Tianming hadn't called just now, she might have really been with Chen Qingyun... In fact, deep down in her heart, there was a faint expectation and desire.But after all, she is a traditional woman. Over the years, she has kept herself as pure as a jade and has always been honest in the face of countless suitors.Chen Qingyun's bold move had already inspired her buried desire. Now she was staying alone in the empty bedroom, but she suddenly felt lonely and seemed to want a man to warm her.After hesitating for a moment, Jiang Yan lay on the bed, closed her eyes, and began to imagine what Chen Qingyun looked like in her mind... Soon, a gentle hum came from the bedroom.On the other side, Chen Qingyun returned home, feeling excited and a little scared at the same time.He didn't know what happened, but he almost raped Jiang Yan tonight. Fortunately, he stopped at the last step, otherwise Yang Tianming would find out, and he would not be able to survive in Songshan County at all!Chen Qingyun took a hot bath and then went to bed.That night, he had a dream. In the dream, there was a woman who made love with him.At first it was Jiang Yan's charming look, but then she turned into a dignified and elegant Bai Wanru.In the end, the woman turned out to be County Magistrate Tang’s daughter, Tang Linger!Tang Ling'er was only eighteen years old and studying in college in the provincial capital. Chen Qingyun only met her once, but he was deeply impressed by her angelic and pure appearance....the next morning."Ding bell!" The alarm bell rang, awakening Chen Qingyun from his sweet dream.He washed up and went to work at the county government.Before I even entered the office, I heard a discussion from my colleagues."Have you heard, Deputy County Magistrate Yang may not be able to go any further!" "The city is sending a new county magistrate. She is only 30 years old. It is said that she is a woman!" "Really or not? Such a young female county magistrate must have some great background!" At this time, Chen Qingyun walked into the secretarial department.Several colleagues who were still whispering to each other just now dispersed and did not say hello to Chen Qingyun at all, as if they regarded him as nothing.It's no wonder that before, Chen Qingyun was the county magistrate's secretary, with unlimited fame, which inevitably attracted jealousy.Now that County Magistrate Tang has died in a car accident, Chen Qingyun may also have to sit on the bench, and everyone is waiting to see the joke.After a few minutes, a man with a short stature walked in.It was Dai Bin, the chief of the secretarial department.

"Is Chen Qingyun here? The Water Conservancy Bureau is short of people recently. You can be seconded to help out for six months to guard the reservoir!" Dai Bin patted him on the shoulder, smiling, but his eyes were particularly sinister.See the reservoir?Isn't this a demotion?"Chief Dai, I'm afraid this is not appropriate? My establishment is run by the county government, not the Water Conservancy Bureau." Chen Qingyun said solemnly."This is the organization's decision, are you going to disobey it?" Dai Bin raised his voice and slapped him with a big hat.But Chen Qingyun was not a soft persimmon, and immediately retorted: "Excuse me, Section Chief Dai, which leader in the county made the decision, or is it that the leaders don't know and it's you who is up to the trick?" Hearing this, Dai Bin simply stopped pretending and slammed the table."I gave the order, so what?" "To tell you the truth, if I, Dai Bin, are in the secretarial department for one day, you, Chen Qingyun, will never be able to get ahead!" "Don't want to go see the reservoir? Then resign and get out!" Dai Bin spat with flying stars, extremely arrogant.He was the secretary of the former county magistrate, but after Tang Zhihua took office, he disliked his poor writing skills and chose the younger Chen Qingyun, which made him resentful.But he and Chen Qingyun had other holidays.His wife Su Yao is the sister of Chen Qingyun's ex-girlfriend. Once when Su Yao was doing business with him in bed, she called Chen Qingyun's name!Although he knew that it was impossible for his wife to have an affair with Chen Qingyun, she must have fantasized about this tall and handsome brother-in-law!As for Dai Bin, who is short in stature and has a big belly, how can he compare to Chen Qingyun?"Anyway, I left it here. If you don't want to see the reservoir, then you are fighting against the organization, and you will be punished lightly!" Dai Bin said grimly."Okay, I'll go! But I'll be back in a week at the latest, let's see!" Chen Qingyun also said this, and the reason why he said this was naturally confident.Although he lost County Magistrate Tang as his backer, he embraced Jiang Yan's lap again, and it was not difficult to reinstate him....After leaving the county government office, Chen Qingyun took a taxi and went to the reservoir in the suburbs to hand over work with the reservoir station director.The webmaster obviously received Dai Bin's order and arranged the hardest night shift for Chen Qingyun, who had to work from 18:00 in the evening to 6:00 in the morning the next day.Chen Qingyun didn't say much, but he had already decided in his heart that he would hit Dai Bin hard in the face!"Boom!" At midnight, an Audi suddenly drove up and parked at the entrance of the reservoir, still hanging a city license plate.A young woman got out of the car. She was tall, wearing a suit, with beautiful legs wrapped in stockings and high heels.Although she couldn't tell her appearance clearly, her outfit made her look like a fashionable girl from a big city."Why did she come to the reservoir in the middle of the night?" Chen Qingyun sat in the monitoring room, observing her actions.I saw the woman in a suit walking to the edge of the reservoir and looking around.Suddenly, a venomous snake sprang out from the grass not far away, and bit her with its scarlet fangs."Ah ah... there is a snake, help!" The woman called for help, but her foot slipped and she fell into the reservoir with a splash, causing a splash...
